voiceName: Sam - New Zealand, Playful, and Warm (ElevenLabs voice library)

lines.intro: Kia ora, ranger. The pests are after the kiwi eggs. Guard that burrow, and let's get stuck in.
lines.wave1: Heads up, here comes another lot.
lines.wave3: Yeah, nah, they're not done yet. Here they come.
lines.boss: Oh, yeah, nah. That is one massive possum. Take it down!
lines.clear3: Good as gold. Grab a feed while you can.
lines.nestDanger: The eggs are in trouble! Get back to the burrow!
lines.lowHealth: You're looking a bit munted, mate. Find a feed.
lines.victory: Predator free! Absolute legend. The kiwi reckon you're choice.
lines.lostNest: Aw, gutted. The nest's gone. Have another crack.
lines.lostPlayer: Ranger down. Yeah, nah. Give it another go.
